info.title: Other - cisco-evpn-service
info.description:
This module contains a collection of YANG definitions for
     managing L2 EVPN services.

**Authentication**: HTTP Basic Authentication

**Protocol**: RESTCONF (RFC 8040)

**Base Path**: https://{device}/restconf/data

**YANG Model:** [cisco-evpn-service.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/cisco-evpn-service.yang)

**📊 YANG Tree:** [View cisco-evpn-service structure](https://jeremycohoe.github.io/cisco-ios-xe-openapi-swagger/yang-trees/cisco-evpn-service.html)
